profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS) since 2021, I specialize in cloud computing, software design, and engineering. My work has focused on architecting innovative solutions, including an AIOps stack leveraging AWS services to automate e-invoicing corrections and improve operational efficiency.  

I have led cross-functional initiatives and developed scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems for enterprise-level billing and data processing, ensuring accuracy and reliability. My mission is to drive impactful results by delivering high-assurance and efficient software systems that address complex challenges in the cloud computing domain.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected an LLM-powered AI-Ops observability and remediation stack that ingested and classified service logs, automatically identifying and resolving e-invoicing errors using CloudWatch, Kinesis, and AWS Bedrock, reducing manual operational support tickets by 20%.

• Lead Engineer for the 2026 Belgium B2B E-Invoicing mandate; architected a high-assurance data transformation engine that secured millions in monthly revenue by mapping complex invoices into PEPPOL-compliant XML with 100% data fidelity.

• Developed a scalable, fault-tolerant distributed billing data service using DynamoDB, S3, and Kinesis to support enterprise-scale AWS bill computation and high-concurrency event processing.

• Led a cross-functional initiative across 15+ AWS teams to design and deploy an asynchronous validation workflow for account-consolidation events, eliminating hundreds of hours of manual analyst work.

• Architected a test account virtualization solution to decouple billing components from physical resource constraints; drove adoption across teams to accelerate end-to-end testing cycles from months to days.

• Modernized legacy billing infrastructure by containerizing EC2 services with Docker and migrating them to ECS/Fargate; built CI/CD pipelines and traffic-shifting deployment strategies that enabled zero-downtime production migrations.

• Launched the consolidated billing service in the air-gapped Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC), meeting stringent security and operational constraints.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Engineering · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed a service health dashboard which monitors the performance metrics of AWS internal services.

•  Designed and implemented a web application, which includes Java-based server-less backend using AWS API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB with a frontend UI built by React.js.
•  Hosted regular customer meetings to collect first-handed user feedback for iterative product development.
•  Provisioned infrastructure for the application using AWS CloudFormation Infrastructure as Code (IaC) service.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Structures

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
Analyzed data from clients, extracted underlying information and provided insights from analytical perspective.

•  Performed customer analysis as well as business hypothesis testing using Python for leading enterprises in industries such as baby care items, food manufacturing and consumer electronics.
•  Built statistical models, including descriptive and predictive, with Python to facilitate decision making.
•  Collaborated with consultants to transform data into business value and develop potential solutions for clients.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Implemented an ad click-through rate (CTR) prediction system with a Factorization Machine + Gradient Boosted Decision Tree model in python to support real-time bidding (RTB) business. 

• Built data pipeline to perform extract, transform and load (ETL) process with kafka, logstash and elasticsearch.
• Designed and implemented automatic data processing in python with about 1,000,000 ad impressions per day.
• Increased app ads CTR by 72.89% and website ads CTR by 42.94% in online testing.
• Achieved 0.82 Area Under ROC curve (AUC) and decreased the logarithmic loss by 21.5% in offline testing.
• Built an HTTP server to deliver prediction results which reached QPS 2000.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Research: Examination of BDT performance with new variables in used for Higgs boson searching
• Work as a member of the ATLAS detector.
• Processed raw experiment data from the ATLAS detector and implemented decision tree classification model to distinguish heavy Higgs decay event from background noise for event analysis.
• Optimized existing heavy Higgs decay event detection model by feature engineering. The model evaluation performance on experimental data from Monte Carlo method was improved by 5.2%.
• Engaged in content production of internal notes and periodic research reports of the research center.

positions.title: Summer Research Intern
positions.description:
Research topic: Plasma phenomena via numerical simulation 
• Work in Prof. Masahiro Hoshino Research Group​.
• Use C++ to simulate the evolution of electrostatic plasma.
• The research covers from general particle motion to plasma instability.
• Successfully reproduced equilibrium plasma modes and plasma evolution from instability to equilibrium observed in physical experiments.
